# truefoundry_virtual_mcp_server (Resource)

Manages a virtual MCP server on the TrueFoundry AI Gateway: an aggregation of existing MCP servers exposed as one endpoint, optionally restricted to a subset of their tools. Applied as an `mcp-server/virtual` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`; the control plane rejects source servers that do not exist. Existing servers can be imported by their FQN, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_virtual_mcp_server.example my-tenant:mcp-server:my-server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A virtual MCP server aggregating existing MCP servers into one endpoint,
# exposing only a curated subset of their tools.
resource "truefoundry_virtual_mcp_server" "docs" {
  name        = "docs"
  description = "Curated documentation tools"

  servers = [
    {
      name          = truefoundry_mcp_server.deepwiki.name
      enabled_tools = ["ask_question"]
    },
    {
      name = truefoundry_mcp_server.internal_api.name
      auth_headers = {
        "X-Api-Key" = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::internal/api_key"
      }
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Human-readable description shown to gateway users and AI agents.
- `name` (String) Name of the virtual MCP server (3-73 characters; must start with a lowercase letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Changing it replaces the server.
- `servers` (Attributes List) MCP servers aggregated by this virtual server, referenced by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

### Optional

- `collaborators` (Attributes Set, Deprecated) Subjects with a role on this virtual MCP server; use `truefoundry_role_binding` instead. Unset leaves the grants on the control plane untouched (and they are not tracked); an empty set clears them, which is only accepted until 15 Nov 2026. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collaborators))
- `tags` (Map of String) Free-form key-value tags on the virtual MCP server.

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the virtual MCP server, e.g. my-tenant:mcp-server:my-server.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the virtual MCP server.

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of an existing MCP server on the same tenant, e.g. truefoundry_mcp_server.example.name.

Optional:

- `auth_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers overriding the source server's authentication for requests via this virtual server. Values accept TrueFoundry secret references (recommended); the control plane returns them as stored, so drift is detected.
- `enabled_tools` (Set of String) Tools of the source server exposed through this virtual server. Omitted means all tools.


<a id="nestedatt--collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collaborators`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) Role to assign, e.g. mcp-server-user or mcp-server-manager.
- `subject` (String) Subject FQN, e.g. user:jane@example.com or team:everyone.
